title: Convex Order Beyond Dimension One: Projection Tests, Counterexamples and Gaussian Mixtures
abstract: arXiv:2610.07404v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In actuarial science and quantitative finance, convex order provides a natural way to compare risks with the same mean. In dimension one, convex order is well understood through several characterisations. In higher dimensions, a natural approach is to compare all one-dimensional projections, but, although necessary, the resulting condition is in general not sufficient for multivariate convex order. A simple counterexample due to Pinelis exploits Popoviciu's inequality. We revisit this example using gauge functions, and show that gauge functions themselves do not suffice to characterise multivariate convex order for symmetric distributions, even in dimension two. We then show that the radial case makes the source of the failure transparent and construct radial counterexamples in every dimension at least two. translated_title: 超越一维的凸序：投影检验、反例与高斯混合
translated_abstract: 在精算科学与定量金融中，凸序为比较均值相同的风险提供了一种自然的方式。在一维情形下，凸序已通过多种刻画方式得到了充分的理解。在更高维的情形下，一种自然的做法是比较所有的一维投影，但尽管这一条件是必要的，它通常并不足以保证多元凸序。Pinelis 给出的一个简单反例利用了 Popoviciu 不等式。我们借助规范函数重新审视这一例子，并证明规范函数本身也不足以刻画对称分布的多元凸序，即使是在二维情形下亦是如此。随后我们证明，径向情形使这一失效的根源变得清晰明了，并在每一个维数至少为二的情形下构造出了径向反例。尽管如此，投影检验对于某些重要的分布族仍然是充分的，特别是……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明所有一维投影的比较检验一般不足以刻画多元凸序——在维数至少为二的每一种情形下都构造出了径向反例，但同时也表明投影检验对包括高斯混合在内的某些重要分布族仍然是充分的。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that comparing all one-dimensional projections is generally insufficient for multivariate convex order—constructing radial counterexamples in every dimension at least two—while proving that projection tests remain sufficient for important families of distributions such as Gaussian mixtures.
